payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of how words are matched and reordered based on the differences in word order between source and assisting languages.

claims.text: Pre-ordering English sentences to match the word order of the source language improves contextual representations and translation quality.
The CFILT-preorder system uses generic and Hindi-tuned rules to reorder English sentences for better alignment with Indian languages.
Handling word-order divergence is crucial for effective transfer learning in multilingual neural machine translation.
